from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document relevant to the task."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the legal document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    legal_documents: list[LegalDocument]
